title: Waste and planting drives at Ashok Hall School · AquaTerra
description: A waste management workshop and Grow Green plantation drives at Ashok Hall School in Kolkata, run by AquaTerra students in 2023 and again in 2025.
lede: AquaTerra has run {count} drives at Ashok Hall School since {firstYear}. They started with a waste management workshop for children in August 2023 and came back in August 2025 for a Grow Green plantation.

sections.heading: what we did at Ashok Hall School
body: The first visit, on 27 August 2023, was a Waste Management Workshop for children. It used games, demonstrations and storytelling to build eco-conscious habits, and it ran on the same day as a Grow Green plantation drive at the school.
We came back in August 2025 with another Grow Green plantation, and the drive notes 100 saplings planted. Across {count} drives there were {volunteers} volunteer turnouts.

sections.heading: why waste and planting go together
body: The workshop and the plantation are about the same idea: small habits about waste and planting in the ground add up. AquaTerra came back two years after the first visit, with a planting drive rather than a workshop, so the school's visits changed with the work.

sections.heading: working with schools like this
body: Schools that want to host a waste or planting session can read the [for schools](/impact/for-schools) page, and students who want to run one can join AquaTerra and sign up on the projects page. See [every school we have worked in](/impact/schools-we-have-visited) for the rest.

learnings: A workshop and a planting drive on one day can cover both ideas: waste first, then the ground.
A return visit can be a different kind of drive, as the 2025 plantation after the 2023 workshop shows.
Environment topics suit children of many ages, since the workshop was built around games and hands-on activity.

faqs.q: Has AquaTerra worked at Ashok Hall School?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra has run {count} drives at Ashok Hall School, from a waste management workshop in August 2023 to a Grow Green plantation in August 2025.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra teach at Ashok Hall School?
faqs.a: A Waste Management Workshop for children, using games, demonstrations and storytelling to build eco-conscious habits around waste. It ran on 27 August 2023.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra plant trees at Ashok Hall School?
faqs.a: Yes. Grow Green plantation drives were held at the school in August 2023 and August 2025, and the 2025 drive notes 100 saplings planted.

faqs.q: How can a school host an AquaTerra session?
faqs.a: Schools can see the options on the for-schools page or get in touch through the contact page. AquaTerra's students run the sessions, and every drive is written up on the site.
